instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend + Vite/React 19 TypeScript frontend with Tailwind v4). CSS entry is frontend/src/index.css.
Retheme index.css: Import Space Grotesk, Geist and JetBrains Mono from @fontsource-variable. Set default dark theme values in .dark and :root.
Ensure index.html has class='dark' on the <html> tag so dark mode is active by default.
Implement comprehensive mock + live FastAPI endpoints for games library CRUD, news feed with AI summary mock, updates tracker, release calendar, and user profile.
Build the Command Palette (Ctrl+K or Cmd+K) accessible from anywhere in the app with grouped instant results (Jogos, Notícias, Patches, Ações Rápidas).

Provide rich interactive states: card hover glow, tab switches, list/grid toggles, tag filter chips, star/numeric rating selector, private notes editor with autosave, and Sonner toast feedback for all CRUD operations.

Language is Portuguese (pt-BR) throughout all UI labels, dates (e.g. '24 de agosto de 2026'), status badges ('Jogando', 'Quero jogar', 'Zerado', 'Completado 100%', 'Pausado', 'Abandonado'), and navigation links.
Always include data-testid on every button, input, navigation link, card, and filter pill for robust automated testing.
